question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Some health experts optimistically argue that disinfecting indoor spaces with light could be a ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is "**game-changer**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the word "optimistically" in the sentence suggests that the health experts believe this approach could be very effective.
 
• Now, among the given options, the correct word to use is "game-changer." 
 
• **"Game-changer" is an idiomatic expression that means something that completely alters the situation or the way things are done**.(खेल परिवर्तक)
 
 
• Example: The hit show has been a game changer for the network.
 
 
 
• The use of light to disinfect indoor spaces is a new and innovative approach that has the potential to change the way we think about cleaning and sanitizing.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "interchanger", means to put each of (two things) in the place of the other.(अदला-बदली करने वाला)
 
• Option 3, "hand over", is a phrasal verb that means to give something to someone else. (हस्तांतरण)
 
• Option 4, "roundabout", is an adjective that means indirect or lengthy. (गोल चक्कर)
